description: She wears an ivory floor-length gown with a low square neckline and fitted bodice, edged with burgundy-gold geometric embroidery. A burgundy-gold flowing outer wrap rests along her arms; a broad decorated waist belt has a round clasp and hanging ornaments. Gold earrings, pendant, wrist cuff, bracelet, small ring and embroidered gold-brown shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
